ApiError.description: One envelope for every error response: `{ "code", "message" }`.

AuditActionDto.description: One redacted audit row (`audit-read` capability; digests only).

ConfigSnapshotDto.description: The complete committed snapshot plus its generation watermark.

CreateConfigProposalRequest.description:
Two-phase proposal creation for sensitive keys (D24). Exactly one of
`patch` / `revert_of_generation` must be present: the latter pre-fills an
emergency-revert patch from that generation's `config_changes` history
(`old` values; pause keys stripped) under the SAME dual control.

DualControlRequest.description:
Dual-control proposal body (unwind / remedial credit / write-off): the
acting principal comes from RBAC; the reason is mandatory.

ledger_txn.description: `None` on a replay observed through a different idempotency key.

FaucetDepositRequest.description: Staging faucet deposit (two-factor mounted; capped; audited).

cost_micro.description: Ranked by committed capital; not mark-to-market value.

InvariantIdentityDto.description: One identity's result inside the invariant report (D27).

PublishStatusDto.description:
`GET /admin/drafts/{id}/publish_status` — the 202 status URL target for
the command-based publish_now (codex r3 NEW-4).

status_url.description: Poll here (also returned by the 202 publish-now authorization).

RemedialCreditRequest.description: Remedial credit body (grok r2 N2): dual-controlled, capped, audited.

SetConfigRequest.description:
Typed patch over the prospective snapshot (D24 write path). Non-sensitive
keys apply directly; sensitive keys are rejected toward the proposal flow.

expected_base_generation.description: Optimistic base; a moved generation is a typed conflict.

SettleConfigProposalRequest.description:
Confirm/reject body: the acting principal comes from RBAC, the reason is
recorded in the audit fact.

config_version.description:
Config generation this preview quoted against (D25a). Echo it back
as `expected_config_version` when placing the trade.

ViewerVoteStatusDto.description:
Viewer-scoped vote state. Deliberately contains no vote-side or crowd-guess
fields because those remain hidden while a market is live.

confirm_dest.description: Required second entry of the destination; both values must canonicalize identically.

parameters.description: Strictly-before cursor (RFC 3339); omit for the newest page.
parameters.name: before

get.description: Fees-account revenue split into trade fees and payout-transaction dust.
Settled/realized PnL in window — not mark-to-market.
Average vote score over markets scored; tier 0 and voters below the configured minimum are excluded.

parameters.description: Filter by lifecycle status, e.g. live
parameters.name: status
